title: Make our bakery hours show up on phones
summary: Our website's opening hours are missing or cut off when customers view the site on a phone. We need the hours to be easy to find and read on any screen size.
tasks: Find out why the hours section is hidden or broken on small screens
Fix the layout so the hours display clearly on phones and tablets
Add the hours near the top of the mobile page or in the footer
Test the site on at least one iPhone and one Android screen size
done_when: Opening hours are visible without zooming on a phone
Hours look correct on both iPhone and Android screen sizes
The desktop version of the site still looks the same
Owner can update the hours text later without help
reward: Verified portfolio entry from Sweet Crumb Bakery plus a free pastry box
